title: POV: Mobile Tower Ki Raat Ke 3 Rules. Teesra Kabhi Mat Todna 🗼
description: Pahad ki choti par mobile tower ki night shift mein kuch ajeeb aawazein aa rahi hain. Yeh ek fictional horror story hai.

scenes.subtitle: Tower par taar galy mein lipti hai۔
scenes.voice: Tower par taar galy mein lipti hai۔
scenes.image_prompt: A close up 2D cartoon picture of YOU standing on a dark hilltop by a giant steel mobile tower, frozen in sheer terror as a heavy black cable slowly wraps around your neck from behind, glowing red eyes in the dark.

scenes.subtitle: Control room ki table par ek purani diary thi۔
scenes.voice: Control room ki table par ek purani diary thi۔
scenes.image_prompt: A 2D cartoon picture of YOU inside a small gloomy control room with blinking green instrument lights, staring down at an old open leather diary resting on a dusty metal table.

scenes.subtitle: Pehla rule: Metal door ko raat bhar lock mat karna۔
scenes.voice: Pehla rول: Metal door ko raat bhar lock mat karna۔
scenes.label: RULE 1
scenes.image_prompt: A 2D cartoon picture of YOU standing cautiously inside the mobile tower base cabin, reaching out a shaking hand toward a heavy metal door while looking back nervously over your shoulder.

scenes.subtitle: Dosra rule: Radio static mein kisi ki baat mat sunna۔
scenes.voice: Dosra rول: Radio static mein kisi ki baat mat sunna۔

scenes.image_prompt: A 2D cartoon picture of YOU pressing a crackling radio walkie-talkie to your ear inside the dark tower cabin, eyes wide open in fear as strange ghostly whispers come from the speaker.

scenes.image_prompt: A 2D cartoon picture of YOU climbing a tall vertical steel ladder of the mobile tower at night, gripping the rungs tightly and looking straight ahead while avoiding the dark abyss below.

scenes.subtitle: Aapne ladder par niche jhunk kar andhere mein dekh liya۔
scenes.voice: Aapne ladder par niche jhunk kar andhere mein dekh liya۔
scenes.image_prompt: A 2D cartoon picture of YOU hanging onto the tower ladder halfway up, peering down anxiously into the pitch black darkness below where pale glowing hands reach up from the ground.
